name: Abdou Yaackoubi
title: Senior Product Designer
tagline: Product direction, interface craft, and an AI-assisted build practice.
intro: What holds my attention is interaction design: how a thing responds, what it does while it waits, and how it recovers. I build to find out: a prototype in code answers questions a static frame cannot.
metaDescription: Product designer. I build what I design.
heroClaim:
Hi, I’m Abdou.
Product designer.
I build what I design.

items.label: Stay next to the build.
items.body: Design that stops at handoff gets built as something else.

items.label: Design for the room you’re not in.
items.body: If a component only works when I’m there to explain it, it isn’t finished.

items.label: Ask for criticism early.
items.body: I’d rather hear it at the prototype than at launch.

aboutIntro.heading:
Design is how I think.
Building is how I prove it.
paragraphs: I’m a product designer based in Tunis. I care most about interaction: how a product responds, what it does while it waits, and how it recovers when something breaks. I map the system first, then prototype in code to check it actually feels right.

heroMeta: Senior Product Designer at InstaDeep, acquired by BioNTech · Six years · Tunis, UTC+1
toolsLine: Figma · Framer · Claude Code · Git · Miro · Notion · Jira
replyTime: Usually a reply the same day.
buildProof: This site is the proof: my Figma, my code, and a test suite that checks its own claims.

metaDescriptions.home: Senior product designer. Six years across fintech, automotive retail and AI: designing products and building them.
